name: saas-rebuild
description: Prove what a SaaS tenant you administer actually uses, keep every byte of its data, and rebuild only what you need. Every feature gets a KEEP / SIMPLIFY / DROP / DEFER verdict the schemas reject unless evidence is cited; everything reachable is exported and checksummed regardless of verdict; replacements are validated by replaying real history. Ships documented export routes for 29 common B2B apps (NetSuite, Salesforce, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Microsoft 365, and more) and a tested export-compliance reference rebuild.
